vision.metaDescription: A labour-market operating system where one person can grow across many roles, activities, and opportunities.
vision.headline: Not a job board. A labour-market operating system.
vision.lede: One person. Many roles over time. A CV born from real work and real confirmations, not self-written claims. The first choice is an entry point, not a cage.

workers.title: Your skills,
workers.subcopy: Build one profile, set your availability, and let real demand find you across borders — no recruiters in the middle.

benefits.title: One profile, every market
benefits.body: Maintain a single avatar with evidence-backed skills and availability — visible to vetted employers across nine countries.

benefits.title: Real demand, real-time
benefits.body: See live opportunities and find roles that fit your trade, rate and location.

benefits.title: Honest signals
benefits.body: Transparent, contextual fit signals — no inflated claims, no universal rating, no pay-to-rank.

companies.title: Opportunity flow,
companies.subcopy: Post what you need on each project and see explainable fit direction from available workers and agencies.

benefits.title: Post demand per project
benefits.body: Define roles, headcount and skills per project — not vague job ads.

benefits.title: Explainable fit direction
benefits.body: Every fit signal comes with the reasons behind it, so hiring decisions stay accountable.

benefits.title: Agencies, when you need them
benefits.body: Tap vetted agency pools for surge capacity without losing visibility.

agencies.title: Your pool,
agencies.subcopy: Manage your managed workers, post demand on behalf of clients, and broker introductions — all in one place.

benefits.title: Manage your pool
benefits.body: Keep your managed workers, availability and statuses organised in one workspace.

benefits.title: Broker with leverage
benefits.body: Share client needs and place the right people faster with explainable fit direction.

benefits.title: Visibility controls
benefits.body: Choose what is public, agencies-only, or direct — you control exposure.

pricing.title: Simple tiers,
pricing.subcopy: Prices are not finalised yet and billing is never started for you on this page. The tiers below describe scope; pilot activation is manual — request a pilot review and we'll confirm pricing and scope with you before anything starts.

pilotActivation.title: Pilot pricing — manual activation only
pilotActivation.body: There is no checkout button on this page. The product is in a pilot stage. No card is collected, no plan activates by itself, and no payment is taken without your explicit decision.
items: Billing is never started for you — when paid plans launch, pricing will be announced at least two weeks in advance.
Organisation status is never set for you — every status comes from owner or admin review.
No silent trial — we won't quietly start charging after a trial window.

pricing.planCta: Join the waitlist for this plan

faq.q: Why is there no price shown yet?
faq.a: We're pre-launch. Setting a price we can't yet stand behind would be dishonest, so tiers show their scope and the price is confirmed before launch.

faq.q: Will the Free tier stay free?
faq.a: Yes. The Free tier is meant to get workers and small employers onto the market with no cost.
Billing integration is planned for a later milestone. In M0 you can only join a waitlist — no card is collected.
Yes. Tiers are meant to follow your needs; you'll be able to move up or down.

legal.draftNote: This document is a draft. The final, binding text will be reviewed by legal counsel before public launch (M5).

pilotReadiness.title: Pilot version
pilotReadiness.body: This is a pilot release of labourmarket.ai for real testers. Your entries are private. No public 'verified' marker. No matching. We're proving the foundation — a reliable evidence chain from free text to confirmed work.
pilotReadiness.feedbackHint: Confusing copy? Highlight + click 'Report copy' bottom-right.
pilotReadiness.telemetryNote: Privacy: we collect task durations + error codes + route paths only. No text from you. No keystrokes. No hidden tracking.

pilotMode.title: Pilot mode
pilotMode.body: No payment, hiring decision, or verification happens automatically here. Real activation requires owner or admin review.

tier2Readiness.title: What Tier-2 (manual activation) will eventually require
tier2Readiness.body: Tier-2 is the manual-activation tier for organisations that want a serious pilot. This card is a preview of what an owner or admin will ask for when you request a pilot review. Nothing on this page is submitted to the Tier-2 schema today, and Tier-2 status stays 'pilot' until owner / admin review completes.
tier2Readiness.requirementsTitle: Information the manual review will ask for
requirements: Organisation legal name and country of registration.
Correspondence address: country, city, street line, postcode.
One named human representative with their role (director, authorised representative, employee, or contractor).
Multi-country presence, when the organisation operates in more than one country.
tier2Readiness.reviewNote: An owner or admin reviews each submission manually. Tier-2 status stays 'pilot' until that review completes; activation happens only after the human review records a decision.
tier2Readiness.notWritingNote: This page is a preview. It does not submit anything to the Tier-2 schema. It does not collect a card. It does not start billing.

profileCvClarity.title: What your profile is built from
profileCvClarity.intro: Your profile grows from real work, not promises. Here are the pieces that shape it, and what is still waiting for evidence.

about.label: About me / experience
about.body: A short self-written intro. Nothing checks or publishes it automatically.

skills.label: Skills
skills.body: Self-chosen skill labels. Visible only to you and the admin — never exposed to employers until you decide otherwise.

journal.label: Work journal
journal.body: Real shifts and tasks you log. Entries are append-only — history is never rewritten. This is the strongest signal about your experience.

selfDeclared.label: What you declared yourself
selfDeclared.body: Everything you typed yourself (languages, documents, prior employers) is a self-declared fact. The system does not auto-confirm it or call you 'verified'.

awaitingProof.label: What is awaiting proof / external confirmation
awaitingProof.body: Skills or achievements that need an employer or institution to confirm them stay marked 'awaiting proof'. There will be no fake 'AI confirmed' or 'Verified' badge.

profileCvClarity.footnote: If the system does not know something — it says so. We do not hide uncertainty behind fake confidence.

company.title: Team core
company.intro: This will hold your team — real people, current roles and who is working this week. There are no members yet, so we show only the empty state instead of made-up examples.
company.footnote: Invitations, roles and availability windows will land in a later stage. We will not invent people.

agency.title: Candidate bench
agency.intro: This will show your active candidates — who is ready, who is currently engaged, who is waiting for the next season. There are none yet, so we show an empty state instead of fake profiles.
agency.footnote: Bench management, availability windows and team recommendations will land later, step by step.

agentOs.subtitle: Internal agent roles helping run the real-tester pilot. Read-only — no live agent runtime yet.
agentOs.statusV1Body: v1 ships role cards only + links to the specs under docs/agent-os/. No live agent execution yet — each role is a written contract for the owner to reason against.
agentOs.footnote: Admins only. Agent descriptions are not auto-executed.

prReadiness.summary: Open PRs status: mergeability, CI, Vercel preview, Supabase preview, migration risk, owner action required.

migrationAuditor.summary: Diff between repo migration files and the production ledger: duplicate numbering, idempotency, RLS/grants, production apply status.

testerJourney.summary: Tracks task starts/completions/durations, identifies where testers abandon: login, CV/profile, Work Journal, language feedback, drafts.

cvProfile.summary: Watches profile/CV creation funnel: profile_text_saved, skill_suggestion_confirmed, skill_edit, feedback. No raw text in telemetry.

workJournalEvidence.title: Work Journal Evidence
workJournalEvidence.summary: Unknown phrase counts, journal save errors, edit/delete usage, parser-review suggestions (no auto-promotion).

languageQa.summary: Reads the language_feedback admin inbox, groups by route/locale/selected_text, suggests LT/EN wording fixes.

securityPrivacy.title: Security / Privacy
securityPrivacy.summary: Checks admin-only access, RLS expectations, no service_role runtime, no raw text in telemetry, no public exposure.
